# El catálogo de los tests.

[remote]
name = "nas"
type = "sftp"

[defaults]
remote = "nas"
device_remote = "disp"

[[pair]]
name = "notas"
local = "sync-data/notas"
remote_path = "/copia/notas"

[[pair]]
name = "fotos"
local = "sync-data/fotos"
remote_path = "/copia/fotos"
mode = "down"
